LanguageData.TribalTrophies_TongueCutting_Message_Wil: Cutting out the tongue of {TARGET_nameDef} will anger {FACTION_name}.
LanguageData.TribalTrophies_TongueCutting_Message_Pro: People of {PLAYERFACTION_name} have attempted to cut out the tongue of {TARGET_nameDef}, and {TARGET_pronoun} resisted. {FACTION_name} is angered.
LanguageData.TribalTrophies_TongueCutting_Letter_Gift: They do not practice the barbaric custom of cutting out tongues.
They have no use for dried tongues.
They do not enjoy being reminded that their own people were silenced.
LanguageData.TribalTrophies_TongueCutting_Gizmo_Desc: Mark for tongue cutting. Colonists assigned to doctoring, cooking or handling (able to cut flesh) will take the job.\n\nA tongue removed by surgery does not become a trophy.
LanguageData.TribalTrophies_TongueCutting_Designator_: Order colonists to cut out the tongue of every person and corpse in the area whose tongue can be taken.\n\nA tongue removed by surgery does not become a trophy.
Must designate a target whose tongue can be cut out.
LanguageData.TribalTrophies_TongueCutting_Item_CutOut: This tongue was cut out by {CUTTER}.
LanguageData.TribalTrophies_TongueRequest_Message_Tar: {FACTION} has learned that you agreed to hunt its people for their tongues.
LanguageData.TribalTrophies_TongueRequest_Gizmo_Deliv: Hand over the dried tongues of {TARGET} this caravan carries, up to the number still requested.
The caravan carries no dried tongues of {TARGET}.
Hand over {COUNT}x dried tongue of {TARGET} to {FACTION}?
LanguageData.TribalTrophies_TongueRequest_Message_Del: {FACTION} received {COUNT}x dried tongue of {TARGET}. Delivered so far: {DELIVERED}/{TOTAL}.
